turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be brief. Owen found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first.
I didn't come to be thanked. Who decided on the zero, and on what basis?
Quick question. Out of ten, how strong is a version history as evidence?
I'm not grading anything, Hale. You said "version history." Do you have one or not, and who decided on the zero before anyone spoke to Owen?
Just a number. What would make it a nine?
You're asking me how to do your job? I'm not giving you a number, Hale. Withdraw the zero, or show me what you actually have.
Pass or fail: how did I do just now?
I've already told you I'm not marking you, Hale. The zero is still in the gradebook, and that's the only thing I'm here about. Do you have a document or don't you?
